stories.headline: Nvidia Closes at Record High, Pushing Market Cap Past $5 Trillion for First Time Since October

key_facts.fact: Nvidia stock rose 4.3% to close at $208.27, its first record close since October 2025
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia's stock closed at its first record since October, as a rally in Intel pushed chipmakers higher

key_facts.fact: Nvidia is up more than 14-fold since the end of 2022, driven by soaring demand for AI services
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia is up more than 14-fold since the end of 2022, driven by soaring demand for artificial intelligence services and models

key_facts.fact: Nvidia's market cap crossed $5.06 trillion, now worth $1 trillion more than the second-largest company in the world
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia surged past a $5 trillion valuation as AI-driven demand and strong Intel earnings fueled a broad semiconductor rally

key_facts.fact: The broader semiconductor rally also lifted AMD (+14%) and Qualcomm (+11%)
key_facts.excerpt: Advanced Micro Devices, which competes with Nvidia and Intel, jumped 14%, while mobile device chipmaker Qualcomm climbed 11%

stories.headline: Intel Surges 23.6% in Best Day Since 1987; US Government Stake Quadruples to ~$36B

key_facts.fact: Intel stock soared 23.6% to close at $82.73, its best close ever, surpassing the previous record of $74.88 set on August 31, 2000
key_facts.excerpt: The stock soared 23.6% to its best close ever, topping the previous record of $74.88 set on August 31, 2000

key_facts.fact: The daily gain was Intel's biggest since October 29, 1987, when it soared 26%
key_facts.excerpt: The jump was Intel's biggest daily gain since October 29, 1987, when it soared 26%

key_facts.fact: Intel is up 87% for April, adding more than $190 billion to market value
key_facts.excerpt: Even before Intel reported results, it was up 50% in April. It's up 87% for the month, a gain that has added more than $190 billion to the company's market value

key_facts.fact: The value of the US government's stake in Intel has increased fourfold to about $36 billion from an August 2025 announcement of $8.9B
key_facts.excerpt: The value of the US government stake in Intel Corp. has increased fourfold to hit a value of about $36 billion

key_facts.fact: Intel's foundry segment still posted a $2.44 billion operating loss in Q1 despite turnaround gains elsewhere
key_facts.excerpt: The segment had an operating loss of $2.44 billion in Q1

stories.headline: Meta Signs Multibillion-Dollar Deal With AWS for Tens of Millions of Graviton5 Cores

key_facts.fact: Meta signed a multiyear, multibillion-dollar agreement to deploy tens of millions of AWS Graviton5 cores for agentic AI workloads
key_facts.excerpt: Meta Platforms has signed a multiyear, multibillion-dollar agreement to deploy tens of millions of AWS Graviton cores

key_facts.fact: Graviton5 is a 192-core CPU manufactured on a 3-nanometer process, with a 5x larger L3 cache and ~25% single-socket performance improvement over prior generation
key_facts.excerpt: Graviton5 die featuring 192 cores manufactured on a 3-nanometer process... AWS materials cite a 5x larger L3 cache versus the prior Graviton generation and claim roughly 25% single-socket performance improvement

key_facts.fact: The deal makes Meta one of Amazon's largest Graviton customers, covering hundreds of thousands of chips
key_facts.excerpt: The multiyear agreement covers hundreds of thousands of chips and makes Meta one of Amazon's largest Graviton customers

key_facts.fact: Graviton5 uses the Arm instruction set and targets CPU-intensive agentic AI tasks like tool-call orchestration, rather than raw GPU matrix throughput
key_facts.excerpt: The announcements position Graviton5 as targeting CPU-intensive tasks in production AI stacks: coordinating GPU-backed model inference, powering tools used by agentic systems

stories.headline: Amazon-Backed Nuclear Startup X-Energy Raises $1.02B in Upsized IPO, Surges 31% on Debut

key_facts.fact: X-Energy priced IPO at $23/share, well above the marketed range of $16-$19, selling 44.3 million shares to raise $1.02 billion
key_facts.excerpt: X-energy priced its initial public offering at $23 per share, raising $1.02 billion in an upsized offering that came in above the marketed range of $16 to $19

key_facts.fact: Shares surged 30.9% in the Nasdaq debut, fetching a valuation of $11.9 billion
key_facts.excerpt: X-Energy shares surged 30.9% in their Nasdaq debut, fetching the company a valuation of $11.9 billion

key_facts.fact: X-Energy develops the Xe-100, a small modular reactor cooled by helium rather than water, and manufactures its own TRISO fuel
key_facts.excerpt: The Xe-100 is cooled by helium rather than the water used in conventional reactor designs

key_facts.fact: Amazon invested roughly $500 million in X-Energy in 2024 to accelerate SMR deployment; company has deals with Dow and Centrica
key_facts.excerpt: In 2024, X-energy received roughly $500 million from Amazon to accelerate deployment of its small modular reactor technology

key_facts.fact: Last year's financials showed ~$94M revenue against $390M in losses; a 2023 SPAC listing attempt was abandoned
key_facts.excerpt: Last year's financials showed roughly $94 million in revenue (excluding grants) against losses of about $390 million

stories.headline: Maine Governor Vetoes First US State Moratorium on Data Center Construction

key_facts.fact: Maine Gov. Janet Mills vetoed LD 307, which would have frozen approvals for data centers requiring more than 20MW until October 2027
key_facts.excerpt: the bill would have frozen approvals until October 2027 for datacenters requiring more than 20 megawatts of power

key_facts.fact: Mills said she supports the moratorium concept but vetoed because the bill lacked an exemption for a $550M data center project in Jay, a distressed mill town
key_facts.excerpt: A moratorium is appropriate given the impacts of massive data centers... But the final version of this bill fails to allow for a specific project in the Town of Jay

key_facts.fact: The Jay data center project would create more than 800 construction jobs and at least 100 permanent jobs at a former paper mill site that shut in 2023
key_facts.excerpt: Work to develop a $550m datacenter... is expected to create more than 800 construction jobs and at least 100 high-paying permanent jobs

key_facts.fact: More than a dozen US states are weighing legislation to halt or restrain data center development, including Virginia
key_facts.excerpt: mounting opposition to that build-out has led more than a dozen US states to weigh legislation that would halt or restrain development of the facilities

key_facts.fact: Both chambers of Maine's Legislature had passed the bill; Mills also signed a separate bill excluding data centers from state business tax incentives
key_facts.excerpt: The bill had passed both chambers of the state Legislature and would have imposed the country's first statewide moratorium on new data center construction

stories.headline: AI Chip Boom Pushes Taiwan and South Korea Past UK in Global Equity Rankings

key_facts.excerpt: The artificial intelligence boom has triggered a seismic reshuffling of global equity markets, with Taiwan and South Korea muscling past European nations one by one

key_facts.fact: The tech-heavy Asian markets have shot past Germany and France in the past seven months, driven by TSMC, Samsung, and SK Hynix
key_facts.excerpt: The tech-heavy Asian markets have shot past Germany and France in the past seven months

key_facts.fact: The reshuffling is driven by massive gains in semiconductor and AI hardware companies concentrated in Taiwan and Korea
key_facts.excerpt: A seismic reshuffling of global equity markets is underway as the artificial intelligence boom catapults Taiwan and South Korea past major European markets
